pages.text: CStallly MIDWAY wx-20 May 24, 1984 SERVICE BULLETIN GAME: UP 'N DOWN SUBJECT: OPTION SWITCH SETTING ERROR An error has been found in the option switch setting for "NUMBER OF CARS PER GAME'. Please make the necessary correction in the UP 'N DOWN Parts and Operating Manual on page 1.5 and also on the Option Switch Setting Card which is in the back of the game. WRONG NUMBER OF CARS PER GAME Sw#2 Sw#3 3 CARS OFF OFF 4 CARS ON OFF 5 CARS ON ON RIGHT NUMBER OF CARS PER GAME swH2 SwH3 3 CARS OFF OFF 4 CARS ON OFF 5 CARS OFF ON NOTE: Switches #2 and #3 both ON give unlimited cars (testing).
